risk_if_not_implemented: Without Data Loss Prevention (DLP), sensitive and/or regulated data may be exfiltrated, leaked or transferred outside authorized boundaries without detection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Intellectual Property / Trade Secret Loss (R-EX-9), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14).

compensating_control_1.name: Monitoring For Information Disclosure
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to monitor for evidence of unauthorized exfiltration or disclosure of non-public information.
compensating_control_1.justification: Monitoring For Information Disclosure (MON-19) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) (DCH-40) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Access Enforcement
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege."
compensating_control_2.justification: Access Enforcement (IAC-25) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) (DCH-40) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
